t: 1899 Superz. perfume - a new fragrance for women and men 2024
s: I expected a classic pine-like Christmas tree, resin, and spruce-but if I really try, it’s more like a fresh, tender spring pine shoot, something you wouldn’t immediately identify as pine - despite its greenness, it’s not sour - could even pass as a fine candy - the woody notes come out near the drydown, - the rose is present only very slightly, and not as the classic “grandma” or oriental red rose-it’s more of a white rose, just softening the overall impression - downside (for men): sometimes it has a hint of women’s hair mask or shampoo, you know, that soft-sweet-floral-fruity hair scent after blow-drying, which I actually like on my girlfriend - upside: suitable for any season, any time of day, pleasant and unique - Fradi 1899 is in the Superz perfumes TOP list alongside Soho and Dominance 10/9
